rule: ONE production re-ingest only, after every source-dependent contract is frozen. Never re-ingest to test a contract; qualify on the sentinel first. RELEASE-BLOCKER RULE (owner, 2026-08-28). Do NOT create work because a metric is imperfect. A finding blocks release ONLY if it demonstrably causes one of: source loss, false knowledge, unsupported answers, inability to retrieve answer-bearing evidence, corpus leakage, or pipeline failure. Everything else is recorded and deferred. No further open-ended forensic audits are authorised.

heading never glued to following prose
split_sentences does not drop content after a heading token
test_line_flattening_suppresses_concept_detection INVERTS
literal coverage: zero unexplained loss, zero unexplained overlap

phases.name: PROCEDURE-ARTIFACT-V2
phases.goal: Local task granularity instead of one-artifact-per-document. Shadow-compare DOCUMENT vs SECTION vs PARENT_NEIGHBOURHOOD vs LOCAL_TASK_SEGMENTATION; promote the smallest deterministic mechanism that preserves goal coherence, step order and source locality.
acceptance: sentinel_procedures.md yields 3 coherent artifacts with disjoint step sets
no unrelated-task contamination
deterministic ids
no invented steps
phases.result: Shadow-compared 4 segmentation units with the same detector: DOCUMENT/PARENT collapse 3 tasks into 1, SECTION merges the two sharing a heading, LOCAL_TASK gives 3 with 0 contamination. Also found and fixed two recall defects underneath: newline-splitting shredded hard-wrapped steps, and the open-class verb whitelist saw 5 of 20 steps. Closed-class exclusion + subject detection replaces it. Result: 3 artifacts, disjoint step sets, all 20 steps verbatim in source order, goals from goal markers; facts/boilerplate/transcript yield 0 artifacts. Worker persists every task; counter moved to v2. V1 frozen. 20-test gate, 7/7 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: CONCEPT-INVENTORY-V2
phases.goal: Separate durable concept inventory from the summary top-N. max_concepts=10 stops being a storage ceiling; admission quality still governs.
acceptance: concept count no longer exactly 10/document by construction
effect of P2 measured SEPARATELY from effect of P4
no unlimited noun-phrase junk
phases.result: Isolated the two effects on all 18 docs from the retained spool: cap removal alone 121->975 (x8.1); structure alone 121->122 (x1.0) because the cap already pins every doc at 10; combined 121->1236. P2's real +261 was masked by the ceiling. Lifting the cap alone would admit 32% junk (fragments, bare generics, participles) - the cap was an accidental quality filter - so admission replaces it, reusing entity_admission's GENERIC_HEAD/WEAK_MODIFIERS/DEICTIC_MODIFIERS. 1236->844 admitted; 0/18 docs at exactly 10. summary_rank keeps the top-N as a slice, not a storage decision. 38-test gate, 8/8 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: PARENT-SUMMARY-ENTITY-CAP
phases.goal: MAX_ENTITIES=10 binds on 58.6% of parent summaries. Determine routing-only vs semantic loss; repair only if entities become unreachable to navigation.
acceptance: entities excluded from the top-10 summary still reachable via authoritative child/artifact evidence
phases.result: OUTCOME A - routing-only cap, NO CHANGE. 280 cases, 11 parents (26-67 durable entities), FAST+HYBRID, all lanes live. In-summary controls 38.8% unreachable vs omitted 30.8% => omission moves reachability -8.0pp (omitted fare slightly better). Mechanism: parent_summaries.entities is read on no retrieval path and never enters embedded routing text; omitted evidence recovered via MULTI_REPRESENTATION/GLOBAL_CHILD_RESCUE/SECTION_LED. Separate finding routed to P16: ~33% of bare entity-name queries miss at top-10 regardless of the cap. Also pinned SOURCE-RECOVERY-KEY-V1 (source_hash not content_hash; 12/12 vs 0/12) as a P14 precondition. 11 tests, 6/6 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: FACT-RECALL-DIAGNOSIS
phases.goal: Sentinel clean SVO sentences produced 3 relation candidates and 0 accepted facts. Trace each to its FIRST rejecting mechanism and classify CORRECT_REJECTION vs a real defect.
acceptance: first rejecting mechanism identified per candidate
clean positives recover IF a defect is proven
negation/hedge/quotation hard negatives remain clean
no global threshold loosening
phases.result: Traced to FIRST divergence: fact_admission_decisions had 0 rows - admission never ran. All 3 candidates died at the rulepack modality gate with scope_gate:negated. Root cause one boundary upstream: v1 flattening glued a heading mid-text so the sentence slice spanned 3 units (135 chars) and 'does not' from a DIFFERENT sentence set negated=True. All 3 rejections were CORRECT given corrupt input - a chunking defect, not an admission defect. No threshold loosened, admission untouched (pinned). SECOND FINDING: V2 alone would have made it WORSE - preserved newlines + newline-splitting shredded hard-wrapped prose (7 of 20 slices, splitting 'Nessus was'/'developed by Tenable'). Fixed with length-preserving _soften_wraps in the V2 path only. After: 4/4 positives ACCEPT, negation REJECT, refutation QUALIFY(attributed), hedge QUALIFY(speculative). 12+4 tests, 4/4 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: EVIDENCE-TRUNCATION
phases.goal: source_sentence[:300]. Determine display-snippet vs evidence authority; ensure full evidence hydrates from the authoritative chunk.
acceptance: answer-bearing content after char 300 remains provable and citable
phases.note: Bounded check, not a redesign: prove answer-bearing content past char 300 still hydrates from the authoritative chunk. If it hydrates, close. Touches 'inability to retrieve answer-bearing evidence'.
phases.result: CLOSED NO CODE CHANGE. source_sentence is written but read by no answer path; retrieval selects supporting_chunks and Qdrant embeds name:desc. Live: 9/121 concepts at the 300 cap, 0 at the 400 desc cap, 0 without supporting_chunks, and every sampled truncated concept hydrates full text from its authoritative chunk. Snippet is display; chunk is authority. 6-test gate, 2/2 mutations caught after two real gate weaknesses were fixed. Recorded for P16: supporting_chunks is document-wide so citation is imprecise (not evidence loss).

phases.name: GRAPH-LIFECYCLE-V2
phases.goal: Corpus/document deletion must prune derived graph state. Do not rely on query authorization to hide permanent garbage.
acceptance: after supported delete/rebuild, PG expected eligible graph vs Neo4j actual delta = 0
phases.note: Stale graph state answers queries about deleted content = false knowledge. Bounded to delete/rebuild pruning.
phases.result: TWO defects. (1) ACUTE: _neo4j_expand ran LIMIT 20 in Cypher then filtered authorization in Python, so unauthorized edges ate answer slots - 15.6% of REL edges unauthorized, up to 8/20 slots wasted, ACCEPT facts pushed past the limit. Fixed by filtering inside the query before LIMIT. (2) LIFECYCLE: reconciler pruned only Chunk + endpoint-ineligible REL, so Document/Fact/Evidence accumulated forever; pruned 28,855 orphan nodes and extended the reconciler to every derived kind, deleting only what PG proves is gone. Final delta zero: Document 18/18, Evidence 3063/3063, Chunk 8887/8887, Fact 3148<=3184. CORRECTED: the 85 non-ACCEPT REL edges are QUALIFY (hedged/attributed) - legitimate knowledge, not garbage; pinned so they are never deleted. 10-test gate, 3/3 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: PIPELINE-BLOCKED-HEALTH
phases.goal: Bundle-stale quarantine must report BLOCKED with cause, not look IDLE. Hit twice during the audit.
acceptance: mutation: change fingerprinted source while workers run old -> health BLOCKED, cause surfaced, no false IDLE
phases.note: Bundle-stale quarantine reporting IDLE instead of BLOCKED masks pipeline failure. Hit twice during the audit and will be hit again by the P14 rebuild.
phases.result: Quarantined workers recorded status+cause but nothing read it, so a blocked pipeline looked idle - cost two manual diagnoses. Added pipeline_health.py + GET /health/pipeline reporting BLOCKED (with cause and action) / HEALTHY / IDLE. Live fleet at implementation time: 2 of 2 live workers quarantined under BUNDLE_STALE_CODE_DRIFT with 1 stuck ticket, previously invisible. Two draft bugs caught by measurement: counting all 1310 registrations (981 stale) would make BLOCKED permanent, and stage_tickets.state does not exist (it is status, lowercase). BLOCKED does not require a non-empty queue. 10-test gate, 5/5 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: RUNTIME-CONFIG-DEFECT
phases.goal: The orchestrator does not load .env (model_config env_file=None), so it falls back to a built-in Postgres password that does not match the deployed one. /retrieve returns 500 on a normally-launched instance. This is a live pipeline failure and a P14 hazard.
acceptance: a normally-launched orchestrator serves /retrieve without manual env export
misconfiguration fails loud at startup, not as a 500 per request
phases.result: No settings class loaded .env, so all 7 fell back to built-in defaults; PG default password 'polymath' vs deployed 'polymath-dev' made every /retrieve a 500 on a normally launched orchestrator. Root cause: pydantic-settings resolves a relative env_file against CWD and the app launches from orchestrator/. Fixed with an absolutely-resolved _ENV_FILE wired into all 7 classes, plus validate_startup() in the lifespan before serving with named terminal codes (POSTGRES_CONFIG_MISSING/AUTH_FAILED/UNREACHABLE) and no password echoed. VERIFIED: normal launch serves /retrieve 200 with 10 evidence; wrong credential gives STARTUP BLOCKED + exit + health 000 + 0 password leaks. 11-test gate, 5/5 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.

phases.name: SUMMARY-IDEMPOTENCY
phases.goal: TWO defects, one symptom. (1) CONTROL PLANE: summary_jobs has no uniqueness beyond the surrogate ticket_id, so identical work is re-ticketed - MEASURED 21,315 PARENT_SUMMARY tickets for 3,025 distinct input_hash values (7.0x average, up to 12x for 533 hashes). (2) CODE: parent_summaries has no supersede semantics - summary_id is content-addressed under ON CONFLICT (summary_id) DO NOTHING (shared/polymath_shared/summary_runtime.py:72-79), so a parent summarised before its entities were ready and again after keeps BOTH rows with no authority marker. MEASURED: 3,025 rows for 1,784 parents; 1,241 parents hold two rows written 4h15m apart with different artifact_hash.
phases.why_blocking: A P14 hazard, not pre-existing clutter. The rebuild re-tickets every parent AND changes contract generation, so the same mechanism can leave one parent holding an old-contract row and a new-contract row simultaneously - exactly the half-old/half-new generation P13 must make impossible - and inflates P17 reconciliation counts. Meets the release-blocker bar under 'false knowledge' and 'pipeline failure'.
acceptance: identical (stage, input_hash) cannot produce a second execution
one authoritative summary row per parent; superseded rows absent or explicitly marked
a contract-generation change can never leave two generations live for one parent
gate mutation-tested
phases.result: Control plane: identity was the run-derived ticket_id, so the done-check never matched across runs and every run re-executed every parent (21,315 tickets / 3,025 input_hashes). Now keyed on (stage,input_hash) for all four stages, unique index enforces it, retries increment attempts. Persistence: parent_summaries had no authority, so 1,241 parents held two rows. Added superseded_at + partial unique index (parent_id) WHERE superseded_at IS NULL, supersede-on-write, and three readers now select the authoritative row; no recency band-aid (pinned). Applied live: summary_jobs 21,516->3,063; 1,784 authoritative summaries, exactly one per parent, 1,241 superseded and retained. Old integration test that encoded the defect was rewritten. 17-test gate, 5/5 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline over 3 runs.

phases.name: ARTIFACT-CONFIDENCE-V2
phases.goal: Confidence is a constant (all procedures 1.00, all concepts 0.90). Either derive a defensible deterministic signal or remove it from semantic use. Length must not imply reliability.
acceptance: no candidate gains ranking/admission advantage from a constant
phases.note: Constant confidence is UNIFORM, so it grants no relative ranking advantage. Not a release blocker. Handle at freeze time as a one-line decision: either drop it from semantic use or stamp it as a declared non-signal.
phases.result: Confidence was worse than a constant: procedure confidence was min(1.0, 0.6+0.05*len(steps)) - a LENGTH function that saturated at 1.0 for 8+ steps (hence looking constant under v1's one-per-document contract) - and ask.py ranked on it, so longer procedures outranked shorter ones. Concept 0.9 was a true constant and could not discriminate. Removed from semantic use in both scorers and replaced the V2 derivation with a declared non-signal; no reliability signal was invented because these compilers select verbatim source. Not in the body hash, so identity unchanged. V1 frozen with its length derivation. 10-test gate, 3/3 mutations caught, suite 83 = baseline.
